Third-party code served from gocarmo.com itself, so no other host can change what runs on the site or on /admin/.
Each file is byte for byte the published one. Checked on 2026-10-23 against the hashes jsDelivr
(data.jsdelivr.com) and cdnjs (api.cdnjs.com) publish. To update: download the new version from the same
URLs, check its hash the same way, and change the paths in index.html and admin/index.html.

esm-env is mapped in index.html the way a bundler resolves it for browsers in production:
esm-env/browser -> true.js, esm-env/development -> false.js, esm-env/node -> false.js.
